issues.body: The prior round's substantive defect is unchanged. Section 7 still says P1-P6 are unfiled, and P0 is only another Markdown action rather than durable tracking. P1-P6 describe concrete security, correctness, availability, and governance work, while the repository contract requires future work to be captured as beads rather than Markdown TODOs. With only the parent sq-vrye bead and no child task IDs, the exit-condition guards and GPU hardening work can still be lost.
issues.fix_hint: Create beads for P1-P6 (combining tightly coupled items is acceptable), link them as children or dependencies of sq-vrye, export the task state through the repository's normal beads workflow, and replace P0 and the unfiled markers with the resulting bead IDs.
issues.title: P1-P6 remain untracked follow-up work

verdict.summary: Round 4 is stagnant. The same major tracking defect from round 3 remains: P1-P6 are concrete security, correctness, availability, and governance follow-ups, but they are still recorded only as unfiled Markdown plan rows. P0 merely instructs a future actor to create durable tasks and is itself untracked. This conflicts with the repository's beads-only rule for future work and leaves the proposed isolation guards, malformed-input correctness checks, bounded GPU execution, exit model, and governance updates liable to be lost. The document is candid about the gap, but candor does not resolve it.
